metaDescription: EventLead scans business cards, manages your contacts and enriches event leads with AI — so you can focus on connecting, not typing.
homeBadgeText: The AI assistant for event-driven teams
homeTitleLine1: From business cards to qualified leads
homeSubtitle: EventLead scans business cards at events, organizes your contact base and uses AI to enrich lead information — so you can focus on connecting instead of typing. Get started in minutes.
homeStrip1: Multi-language OCR vi · en · ko · ja · zh
homeStepsSubtitle: Three steps from paper to clean data in EventLead.
homeStep1Description: Take a photo at the event — AI extracts all 7 fields with a confidence score for each.
homeStep2Description: The agent finds company details, industry and opportunities from public web sources.
homeStep3Description: Every field waits for your confirmation before entering the contact base — AI suggests, humans decide.
homeFeaturesSubtitle: Six capabilities designed for the post-event lead lifecycle.
homeCtaSubtitle: Create an account in minutes — and scan your first card today.
homeFeatureScanDescription: Snap a photo of a business card and let AI extract accurate contact details automatically.
homeFeatureContactsDescription: Keep every lead organized with dedupe checks, companies and follow-up notes.
homeFeatureEnrichmentDescription: Enrich leads with company data and draft personalized follow-ups in one click.
homeFeatureRelationshipsDescription: Map how leads, companies and teammates connect so no opportunity slips away.
homeFeatureAssistantDescription: Ask questions about your leads and get instant answers grounded in your own data.
homeFeatureExportDescription: Export your contacts to CSV whenever you need them in another tool.
homeEcosystemHeading: The post-event lead platform for teams.
homeEcosystemDescription: From the first scan to the signed deal — EventLead keeps every lead from your events organized, enriched and ready to follow up. Get started in minutes.
